title: chore(deps): fix all Dependabot security alerts
body:
Resolves all 11 open Dependabot security PRs (#22–#32) by updating vulnerable dependencies directly rather than merging each PR individually.

# Work Item

Dependabot PRs #22–#32

# What

**`apps/backend/package.json` — direct dependency bumps:**
- `express` `^4.19.2` → `^4.22.1` (CVE-2024-51999)
- `axios` `^1.7.7` → `^1.13.5` (DoS fix)
- `@aws-sdk/client-s3` + `s3-request-presigner` `^3.901.0` → `^3.987.0` (pulls in safe `fast-xml-parser`)
- `nodemailer` `^7.0.9` → `^7.0.11` (stack overflow DoS in addressparser)

**Lock file regeneration — transitive/indirect fixes:**
- `apps/backend/package-lock.json`: `diff` → 4.0.4, `undici` → 7.25.0, `@smithy/config-resolver` → 4.4.17, `js-yaml` → 3.14.2, `qs` → 6.15.1, `fast-xml-parser` → 5.7.2; also auto-fixes `brace-expansion`, `minimatch`, `follow-redirects`, `express-rate-limit`
- Root `package-lock.json`: `lodash` → 4.18.1, `node-forge` → 1.4.0, `js-yaml` → 3.14.2 + 4.1.1 (prototype pollution fix)

**Remaining (require major version breaking changes — out of scope):**
- `aws-sdk` v2 region validation (fix = `aws-sdk@1.18.0`, not viable)
- `nodemailer` SMTP injection (fix = v8.x major bump)
- `uuid` buffer bounds (transitive via `aws-sdk`)

# Why

Clears the security alert backlog with non-breaking updates. Breaking-change items require separate evaluation before upgrade.
